summary: Google's Gemini Developer API pricing page lists Gemini 4 Hydrogen (model ID gemini-4-hydrogen). On the Free Tier, input, output (including thinking tokens) and context caching are free of charge. On the Paid Tier they cost $1.50, $7.50 and $0.075 per 1M tokens. The Free plan gives limited access to certain models with free input and output tokens. Free-tier rate limits are not published on the rate-limits page and can be viewed in Google AI Studio.
claim_steps: Sign in to Google AI Studio and create a Gemini API key on the Free tier
Call the model ID gemini-4-hydrogen; check your rate limits in Google AI Studio

social_proof.title: Gemini Developer API pricing
social_proof.text: Gemini 4 Hydrogen (gemini-4-hydrogen). Standard, per 1M tokens in USD — Input price: Free Tier 'Free of charge', Paid Tier '$1.50'; Output price (including thinking tokens): Free Tier 'Free of charge', Paid Tier '$7.50'; Context caching price: Free Tier 'Free of charge', Paid Tier '$0.075'. Free plan: 'Limited access to certain models', 'Free input & output tokens'.

social_proof.title: Rate limits
social_proof.text: Rate limits depend on a variety of factors (such as your usage tier) and can be viewed in Google AI Studio.
